name: BACH_0143
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (72%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Tier 3 flag for low reliability (41%) [F6] and Normal vs Benign ambiguity [F1]; recut and deeper levels drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 72%, Benign 27%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Favors Normal; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (alpha 10%; 90% dataset coverage) | Cannot separate Normal from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 41% reliability, 22nd OOD percentile (12 tiles kept) | Suspect input; confidence reduced |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent models disagree on top |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Normal (80%) [F5]; 1 Benign (92% similar) | Reference neighbors mostly match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 1, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.51 (contribution -1.29) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot check (unreliable) · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 1, 5, 10) · context · Descriptive score 1.45 (contribution -0.95) [F3]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.22 (contribution -0.39) away from invasive [F4]; 20/20 spot check · Validated
- **HoVer-Net nuclei segmentation** (regions 0, 4, 11) · context · 7 neoplastic nuclei in region 11 (6% fraction); insufficient tumor nuclei · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in dataset deletion (+0.0114 vs random, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132); case region risks are 0%.
- **Concepts**: Unproven in deletion (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); case leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- The tissue is Benign (27% probability, in 90% conformal set, 92% similar to Benign case BACH_0029).
- Poor slide quality (41% reliability, 22nd OOD percentile) or unsampled levels mask atypia, driving CONCH–MUSK disagreement.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 6, 9**: Verify two-layered lobules versus benign lesion; the normal-lobule concept score is unreliable (0/20).
2. **Regions 1, 5, 10**: Check dense lymphocytes (TILs) and inspect region 10 ducts for atypia.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 11**: Assess section quality (recut/deeper levels drafted) and check 7 neoplastic-flagged nuclei in region 11.
